messages:
eva: Quick sync: we need to change how SDKs surface routing metadata for the console. Current plan is to add a lightweight header `X-RW-RouteMeta` with a compact token. Concerned about breaking clients/proxies. Thoughts?

tom: Compact token sounds fine. Major ask: make it opt-in via env var so customers with strict proxies don't get surprised. Also ensure we can emit it alongside the existing `X-Redwood-Route` for a migration period.

priya: Console ingestion will accept both headers. We'll prefer `X-RW-RouteMeta` when present and fallback to `X-Redwood-Route`. Need an adoption metric so we can track percent of traffic using the new header.

eva: Plan suggestion: SDKs (py/ts/go) add RW_ROUTE_META_MODE env with values `off`, `dual`, `new-only-canary`, `new-only`. Default `off` for the first minor release. Dual emits both headers when set.

tom: Implementation note for Python: requests/urllib3 lowercases keys at some layers. In the client we should set headers with lowercase keys once to avoid duplication: `headers = {"x-redwood-route": v}; if mode in (...) headers["x-rw-routemeta"] = v` and add unit test asserting underlying request receives both keys.

priya: Console: ingestion will add `route_meta_source` field (old,new,both,none). I'll also add a small sparkline tile to the rollout dashboard. If unknown-route spikes >3% after shim, set an alert.

ops-bot: deploy queued: edge-proxy/shim v5 -> staging at 2026-03-25T14:00:00Z

tom: Ops: will the shim map new->old? Some CDNs strip unknown headers. If shim maps new->old, that helps. Also add sampled telemetry `route.meta.seen` with sdk and version so we can attribute adoption by client.

priya: Yes, shim will map new->old for 45 days. We'll also backfill historical records as `old` in the dashboard.

sdk-bot: PR created: sdk-python#482 (adds RW_ROUTE_META_MODE env + tests), sdk-ts#320, sdk-go#211

eva: Timeline: PRs -> minor SDK releases in 5 business days with opt-in `dual`. Shim to staging now, console ingest + tile in 7 days. Evaluate after 6 weeks then decide flip.

tom: One more: enforce route meta token length <= 512 bytes in SDKs; truncate + emit metric `route.meta.truncated` if exceeded. That'll prevent weirdness with downstream systems.

priya: Adding truncation guidance to docs and the rollout checklist.

eva: Great, thanks. I'll draft the migration note and a short support playbook for customers running custom proxies. Closing thread; reopen if blockers show up.
